title: Assistant General Manager-Network Operations(Regional Head )
description:
Dear Aspirants, 
 Greetings from ACT Fibernet!!!!!! 
 Job Description: AGM (Regional Head of Network Operations) 
 Position Overview: 
 The Regional Head of Network Operations will oversee end-to-end management of a large, geographically distributed network infrastructure comprising switches, routers, and the optical transport layer for one of Indias leading Internet Service Providers. This role is responsible for operational excellence, network integrity, SLA compliance, and people leadership across multiple cities and states. Key Responsibilities: Direct and manage end-to-end Network Operations for core, metro, and access networks across several cities and states. Provide technical leadership for a multi-technology environment including L2/L3 switching, routing, Metro Ethernet, GPON, and DWDM networks. Plan, coordinate, and execute new product and technology rollouts, including detailed product/solution qualification and quality assurance (QA) testing. Lead a large team of network engineers and operations managers; provide mentorship, training, and performance management. Ensure robust network monitoring and rapid incident response to achieve and exceed network SLAs (uptime, latency, performance, fault management). Drive continual improvement in network reliability, capacity, and scalability. Oversee root cause analysis and implement preventive and corrective measures for network issues. Manage vendor relationships, especially for hardware (switches, routers, optics) and critical software or monitoring solutions. Regularly review and update network documentation, policies, and procedures. Report to executive leadership on network KPIs, incident trends, and project status. Required Technical Skills: Deep expertise in large-scale routing (OSPF, BGP, MPLS), switching (VLAN, STP, advanced L2/L3 protocols). Proven experience with Metro Ethernet and multi-site WAN design and management. Hands-on experience with GPON, MEN and advanced optical transport technologies (DWDM, FTTx, fiber troubleshooting). Strong command of product qualification and QA methodologies for network and optical equipment. Experience managing network automation, NMS, and monitoring tools. Leadership & Soft Skills: Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate large teams (100+ people) across regions. Exceptional organizational, project management, and communication skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and crisis management abilities. Qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or equivalent; post-graduate degree is a plus. 12+ years relevant experience in core/metro network operations for an ISP or carrier. Certifications (CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, MEF-CECP, or equivalent) strongly preferred. Location:

title: Associate Manager - RGM
description:
**Overview**
 RGM strategy Playbook \- Associate plays a pivotal role in our organization, with a primary focus on brand ladder and price pack architecture analysis, Mix Management and Promo Strategy. This role encompasses a range of responsibilities related to optimizing our product and pricing strategies to maximize brand equity, profitability, and consumer engagement.
   

  

 Key responsibilities of the Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate include:
   

  

* Conducting in\-depth market research and data analysis to identify and evaluate brand positioning / price pack architecture opportunities
* Analyzing consumer behavior and preferences to gain insights into how our brand ladder / pricing strategies impact purchasing decisions
* Developing and refining brand ladder and PPA models and methodologies to streamline decision\-making / enhance operational efficiency
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that our brand and pricing strategies align with overarching business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Utilizing data\-driven insights to enhance the overall consumer experience and perception of our brands and pricing structures
* Contributing to the long\-term brand and pricing strategy of the organization, actively participating in the creation of innovative approaches to optimize brand equity and profitability


 The Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate leverages advanced analytical skills and tools to shape our brand and pricing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our strategic goals, compliance standards, and customer satisfaction objectives
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Functional Responsibilities
   

  

* Perform advanced analytics using Tableau/Power BI and develop predictive models, regression modeling, price elasticity analysis, and promotion optimization to extract actionable insights from data
* Collaborate on sector NRM strategic projects, such as promotions optimization, terms priorities, competitor benchmarking, and Price Pack Architecture (PPA) initiatives, to drive revenue realization
* Conduct statistical and trend analysis to identify market opportunities, highlight sector strengths, and provide recommended corrective actions to enhance performance
* Monitor existing KPI metrics, develop new relevant metrics, and identify correlations and root causes to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Design and build visualization dashboards to accelerate information\-to\-action at scale, enabling easy access to critical insights for various stakeholders
* Develop programs, methodologies, and reports for analyzing and presenting data, making data\-driven insights accessible and actionable
* Ensure the timely and accurate submission of reports and data to the Revenue Management teams in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA)
* Improve the utility of operational and performance data within various teams, supporting Business Intelligence (BI), reporting, analysis, and insights efforts


 Assist the GBS Commercial lead in developing an ongoing training and capability plan for COE associates, ensuring continuous growth and expertise development within the team
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Broader data analysis capabilities. Previous experience in Consumer Insights, Key account Management, Trade Marketing or CPG consulting
* Experience in pricing and promotions management, demonstrating a deep understanding of pricing strategies, market dynamics, and consumer behavior
* Proven experience working in the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector with a strong understanding of business processes related to Revenue Management, including promotions, pricing, and sales
* Excellent visualisation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable solutions and processes, enabling data\-driven decision\-making
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a strong command of PowerPoint, with the ability to quickly learn various in\-house software applications for data analysis and reporting

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager Company: Fleetronix Systems Pvt. Ltd. Location: Hyderabad About Fleetronix Systems Fleetronix Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a growing fleet management and IoT company that builds technology-driven solutions for the logistics and transportation industry. About the Role We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day operational activities, ensure smooth service delivery, and improve the efficiency of our fleet management and IoT operations. This is a customer-facing role, leading a small team and coordinating across technical, support, and sales functions to keep operations running smoothly, with occasional field visits to clients as needed. What You Will Do Manage and oversee daily operations to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery. Supervise a team of 3-4 people and ensure tasks are completed within defined timelines. Coordinate with technical, support, sales, and other internal teams to resolve operational issues. Monitor fleet management activities, service requests, and operational workflows. Track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify gaps, and implement corrective actions. Ensure timely resolution of customer and operational escalations, working directly with clients. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for operational activities. Monitor team productivity, attendance, and performance. Prepare and share regular operational reports with management. Identify process improvement opportunities and implement effective solutions. Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and operational procedures. Support resource planning, manpower allocation, and operational scheduling. Travel for field visits (client sites, depots, etc.) as required, on an occasional basis. Maintain effective communication with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders. What We're Looking For 7-9 years of experience in operations management, with mandatory hands-on experience in the logistics domain (fleet management, transportation, or related). Experience in fast-paced, service-based or tech-driven organizations is preferred in addition to logistics background. Proven experience managing and leading a small team (3-4 people) and coordinating cross-functional operations. Strong knowledge of operational processes, reporting, and performance management. Good communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills; comfortable in a customer-facing role. Proficiency in MS Excel and general operational reporting tools (no specific software required). Familiarity with GPS/vehicle-tracking or IoT-based fleet operations is preferred, not mandatory. Any graduate degree is acceptable - no specific field required. Willingness to travel occasionally for client/field visits.
